bearing.event.v1alpha1.DeclarationChange.description:
DeclarationChanged says a source's adapter was upgraded and now declares
 something else (docs/spec/data-model.md, "Declarations"). The new
 declaration takes effect from the event's record time. Applying it checks
 the declaration against the key types already bound and is rejected
 (invalid_operation) if it changes a bound key type's kind, class or case.

^(adapterVersion)$.description: The adapter's version now, from its Describe result.

^(moduleDigest)$.description:
The module's digest now, "sha256:<hex>", when the adapter is pinned by
 digest.

^(previousAdapterVersion)$.description:
The adapter's version before, from its Describe result; empty for a
 source's first declaration.

adapter_version.description: The adapter's version now, from its Describe result.

module_digest.description:
The module's digest now, "sha256:<hex>", when the adapter is pinned by
 digest.

previous_adapter_version.description:
The adapter's version before, from its Describe result; empty for a
 source's first declaration.

source.description: The configured source whose adapter changed.

bearing.event.v1alpha1.DeclarationChange.title: Declaration Changed

Authority is a source's claim to be the source of record. It is a message
 so levels can be added later without breaking declarations or overrides.

bearing.model.v1alpha1.WebhookSignature..description:
WebhookSignature declares how a source signs its deliveries
 (docs/spec/adapter-protocol.md, "bearing.describe"). It never holds a
 secret: the Source supplies that by reference. It declares no delivery ID
 header: the host names a delivery by the SHA-256 of its body, because the
 IDs senders add (GitHub's X-GitHub-Delivery) are not covered by the
 signature, so a replay could change one and pass the dedupe (threat model
 C-INGEST-5). A scheme whose signature covers a delivery ID would add a
 field for it.

^(signatureHeader)$.description:
The request header that carries the signature, for example
 "X-Hub-Signature-256". Required.

^(signaturePrefix)$.description:
Text before the hex digest in the header, for example "sha256=" or
 "v1=". Empty when the header holds the bare digest.

signature_header.description:
The request header that carries the signature, for example
 "X-Hub-Signature-256". Required.

signature_prefix.description:
Text before the hex digest in the header, for example "sha256=" or
 "v1=". Empty when the header holds the bare digest.
